parameters.content:
## Identify by spoken data

Plate plus surname or postcode against the CASE account (placeholder rule until question 20 is agreed). A match stores the customer on the session and account, asset, VIN or FIN, plate and dealer on the case; a miss counts an attempt.

## AR-18 IdentifyCaller

For IVR calls (no VIN) and unknown VINs. The data points are a placeholder until the identification rule is agreed (question 20; no document holds it); the rule lives in the mock and this tool, nowhere else. A match also writes account, asset, VIN or FIN, plate and dealer to the case. Attempts are counted on the session; the IdentifyExhausted guard in AR-02 hands off after two.

meta.description: Agent tool. Matches the caller against the CASE customer account from spoken data points (registration plate plus surname or postcode; placeholder until the identification rule is agreed, question 20). Inputs: sessionId (plumbed), lastName, registrationPlate, postcode. Stores the identified customer on the session and the account name on the case. Two failed attempts: the dialogue hands off with IDENTIFICATION_FAILED.
